title: Micro-credential Attestation (PuB-EAA) – SD-JWT VC payload
description: Schema for the SD-JWT VC payload of a Micro-credential Attestation issued as a PuB-EAA. Derived from the mandatory attributes (Rulebook 3.2), the conditional workload and subject attributes (Rulebook 3.4), the mandatory metadata (Rulebook 4.1), the conditional metadata (Rulebook 4.3) and the integrity rules (Rulebook 4.5) of the Attestation Rulebook – Micro-credential (PuB-EAA), version 2.0-draft. The schema validates the processed payload, after selective-disclosure digests have been resolved into claims. Optional attributes (Rulebook 3.3) are allowed but not validated.
$comment: Rules that cannot be expressed in JSON Schema and must be checked by issuer or verifier logic: nbf <= exp and iat <= nbf (MC-IR-12); uniqueness of jti per issuer (MC-IR-13); a status list entry never reverts from INVALID to VALID (MC-IR-14); issuer claims present if and only if the JWS header has no x5c, and consistency of iss and issuer data with the qualified seal certificate (MC-IR-15, Rulebook 4.6); the JWS protected header (alg, typ = dc+sd-jwt, x5u, x5t#S256, x5c) defined in Rulebook 5.1.0; the selective disclosability rules in Rulebook 5.1.

vct.description: Verifiable Credential Type identifying the Micro-credential Attestation (PuB-EAA). Resolves to the SD-JWT VC Type Metadata. Rulebook 4.1.

vct#integrity.description: Integrity hash of the Type Metadata document (ETSI TS 119 472-1 EAA-5.2.1.2). Rulebook 4.1.

category.description: Indication that the attestation is a PuB-EAA (Annex VII (a); ETSI TS 119 472-1 PuB-EAA-5.2.2.3). Rulebook 4.1, MC-IR-11.

iss.description: Identifier of the issuer (the PuB-EAA Provider). Must be consistent with the subject of the qualified seal certificate. Rulebook 4.1, 4.6.

iat.description: Time at which the credential was issued (epoch seconds). Rulebook 4.1.

nbf.description: Beginning of the technical validity period (epoch seconds). Annex VII (e). Rulebook 4.1, MC-IR-12.

exp.description: End of the technical validity period (epoch seconds). Reflects the technical validity of the credential instance, not the continued truth of the achievement. Annex VII (e). Rulebook 4.1, MC-IR-12.

jti.description: Attestation identity code, unique for the issuing PuB-EAA Provider, as a UUID URN. Annex VII (f). Rulebook 4.1, MC-IR-13.

status.description: Token Status List reference used for revocation checking. Mandatory for this attestation type. Annex VII (i). Rulebook 4.1, 8, MC-IR-14.

idx.description: Index of the attestation in the status list.

uri.description: URL of the status list token, under the domain of the PuB-EAA Provider.

issuing_authority.description: Name of the issuing public sector body. Option B only: present if and only if the qualified certificate is not included in the x5c header. Annex VII (b). Rulebook 4.3, 4.6, MC-IR-15.

issuing_country.description: Member State in which the issuing public sector body is established, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Option B only. Annex VII (b). Rulebook 4.3, 4.4, 4.6.

iss_reg_id.description: Registration number of the issuing public sector body as stated in official records, built as an organizationIdentifier per ETSI EN 319 412-1 clause 5.1.4. Option B only, where a registration number exists. Annex VII (b). Rulebook 4.3, 4.6.

attestation_legal_category.description: Transitional legal category indication for conformance with ARB_25 of ARF v3.0.0. Never a substitute for category. Rulebook 4.3.

cryptographically_bound_to.description: Attestation type or vct to which this attestation is cryptographically bound, where used. Rulebook 4.3.

sub.description: Subject identifier, where used. Must not be a pseudonym. Rulebook 3.4.

also_known_as.description: Pseudonym of the subject, used instead of sub if the subject is represented by a pseudonym. Rulebook 3.4.

identifier.description: Unique identifier of the micro-credential achievement, assigned by the awarding body. Distinct from jti. Rulebook 3.2.

givenName.description: Learner given name. Annex VII (c). Rulebook 3.2.

familyName.description: Learner family name. Annex VII (c). Rulebook 3.2.

issuerCountry.description: Country of the organisation that sealed the credential, in the ELM sense, from the EU country vocabulary. Does not satisfy Annex VII (b). Rulebook 3.2, 4.6.

awardingBody.description: Public formal education provider that awarded the micro-credential. Rulebook 3.2.

issuanceDate.description: Date on which the credential was sealed and issued. Rulebook 3.2, MC-IR-03.

learningOutcomes.description: Learning outcomes acquired by the learner. Rulebook 3.2.

examples.title: The title of the learning outcome

ECTS.description: Notional workload in ECTS credits. Mandatory for formal learning; mutually exclusive with volumeOfLearning. Rulebook 3.2, 3.4, MC-IR-06.

volumeOfLearning.description: Volume of learning as an ISO 8601 duration, for non-formal learning recorded in the authentic source only. Mutually exclusive with ECTS. Rulebook 3.4, MC-IR-07.

typeOfAssessment.description: Assessment types used to validate the learning outcomes. Rulebook 3.2.

formOfParticipation.description: Form of participation in the learning activity. Rulebook 3.2.

qualityAssurance.description: Type of quality assurance underpinning the micro-credential. Rulebook 3.2.

allOf.$comment: ECTS and volumeOfLearning: exactly one (Rulebook 3.4, MC-IR-06, MC-IR-07).
